overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no evidence the Council deliberated during the June 18 recess, so it credited six members' affirmative denials of outside discussion.

allegations.summary: Complainants alleged the Council deliberated during a ten-minute recess of its June 18 meeting, possibly leading three members to change their votes on the budget.
allegations.key_passage: Absent specific evidence to the contrary, we credit the public body’s version of events that it did not deliberate outside of the June 18 meeting.
